;Description :This template starts a column, as part of a two-column template. ;Syntax :Type {{t|Col-begin}}, then whatever you would like inside the first box, then {{t|Col-2}} and whatever you want in the second box, ended by {{t|Col-end}}. :For example... 
{{Col-begin}}
Text
{{Col-2}}
Text
{{Col-end}}
